_comment: pcf_prep.py job for Revit/Fabrication PCF -> AutoPIPE (Bentley PCF Translator). Every value here is a PLACEHOLDER to replace from the project specification and drawings; paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the script (nested lists and dicts that the script iterates carry no _comment keys, except where noted).
_comment_name: Free text, echoed to the report.
name: example model, supply and return (placeholder)
_comment_pcf_globs: REQUIRED. Globs of the Revit/Fabrication PCF files merged into one model; inch or mm coordinates are detected per file.
_comment_output_dir: REQUIRED. Output folder (created). Files: STEM.pcf, STEM_report.json and the CSVs listed in the pcf_prep.py docstring.
_comment_pipeline_reference: PIPELINE-REFERENCE written to the PCF. Default: the stem.
_comment_assumed: Free-text assumptions, echoed into the report as ASSUMED. Write every basis you took that the drawings do not state.
assumed: PLACEHOLDER: design code, edition and pressure are set in the analysis program; the translator may write a different code than the one you select.
PLACEHOLDER: supports are the BIM layout mined from the NWC, not a support design.
_comment_box_ft: Model box in feet, plant coordinates (the frame of the PCF). Any of xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax; a missing limit is open.
_comment_clip_mode: any = keep a record when any point is inside the box; all = only when every point is.
_comment_heal_tol_in: Joints closer than this (in) are fused into one coordinate; fittings win over pipe ends. Revit gasket faces are typically 0.05 in open.
_comment_min_segment_in: Shortest pipe a support split may leave (in).
_comment_weld_match: Regex on ITEM-DESCRIPTION of records that are weld or gasket stand-ins; with fuse_rtypes they are removed and their two nodes fused.
_comment_fuse_rtypes: Record types that weld_match may remove. Default: COUPLING only.
_comment_retype: Retype records by description regex. Each rule: from (record type), match (regex), to, optional skey. Example: a valve exported as MISC-COMPONENT.
_comment_flange_map: Revit writes flanges as COUPLING. Each rule: match (regex on description), record (FLANGE or FLANGE-BLIND), skey.
_comment_normalize_elbows: Trim elbows that butt another fitting so the translator's bend radius fits. Default true; elbow_margin_in is the leg margin (in).
_comment_elbow_margin_in: Leg margin (in) the elbow trim leaves so the translator radius fits.
_comment_straighten_max_dev_in: Largest off-axis joint (in) moved back onto the line through its neighbours.
_comment_valve_weights: Revit valve WEIGHT is often 0. Each row: match (regex on description), nps, weight_lb, optional source note. PLACEHOLDER weights: replace from submittals.

valve_weights.source: PLACEHOLDER weight, replace from the vendor sheet

_comment_systems: One entry per system, chosen by a regex on the source PCF file name. Written as COMPONENT-ATTRIBUTE1..9 in the order the translator's Attribute Mapping tab expects: pressure, temperature, material, wall, insulation thickness, insulation density, corrosion allowance, (8 = rigid weight, set by the script), fluid density. PLACEHOLDER strings: replace with real values from the project basis.
_comment_desc_schedule_tag: Schedule token appended to every ITEM-DESCRIPTION that has none, so the translator does not default fittings to STD. Set to the line schedule.
_comment_nwc_items_csv: Output of nwc_supports.py --items-out. Used to name in-line items the PCF export left out.
_comment_bridge: Close collinear gaps between free ends with a stand-in for an omitted in-line item (strainer, control valve, meter). max_gap_in: longest gap bridged. reducer_max_gap_in: 0 turns off bridging between two sizes (a dropped reducer). label_radius_in: how far an NWC item may sit from the gap centre to name it. unidentified_label / fallback_labels {nps: text}: names when nothing matches. item_weights: [{match, nps, weight_lb, skey}] by label. by_length: [{nps, len_in, tol_in, label, weight_lb}] name a bridged item by its gap length. as: valve (AutoPIPE VALV, full weight) or rigid. valve_skey: SKEY of a bridged valve.
_comment_not_inline_extra_regex: Extra regex of NWC element names that are never in-line items (project equipment and support family names).
_comment_three_way: Complete a bridged 3-way valve with a real tee so AutoPIPE accepts it. match: regex on the bridged label. port_radius_in: how far off the run the third port may be. tee_leg_in: tee leg length. schedule: schedule token (default desc_schedule_tag).
_comment_supports_csv: Output of nwc_supports.py. Each support is snapped to the pipe it carries and the pipe is split there.
_comment_support_system_match: Regex on the CSV system column. Rows tagged to another system are skipped. Default matches all.
_comment_support_rules: One entry per CLASS in the CSV (CLEVIS, TRAPEZE, STAND, ROLLER, RISER, GUIDE, ANCHOR). max_horiz_in / min_dz_in / max_dz_in: snap window from the BIM point to the pipe centreline (dz positive = pipe above). multi_pipe + max_pipes + same_level_in: one trapeze or stand carrying several parallel pipes. tag_prefix: NAME prefix. node_fallback: allow a fitting node. system_tag_must_match: {system name: regex on the CSV system}. _family_overrides: {family substring: overrides}. _min_support_spacing_in: supports closer than this on one line are merged. All distances are EXAMPLES.
_comment_support_desc_max: Longest SUPPORT ITEM-DESCRIPTION written (translator log width).
_comment_support_skey_override: Map a SKEY the script writes to another one your PCFin.map expects, e.g. {"HANG": "HANG"}.
_comment_infill: Optional rest supports on long unsupported runs. max_span_ft_by_nps {nps: ft} is a cap that MUST come from the project specification: the values here are PLACEHOLDERS. hang_above_ft: runs whose centreline is higher are hung. trigger_factor: a gap must exceed span x factor. join_across_fittings_in, count_run_ends, skey: as in the pcf_prep.py docstring.
_comment_boundary_rules: Classify every remaining free end; the first rule that matches wins. match keys: rtype (regex on the end component), bore, min_bore (in), dir (+X -X +Y -Y +Z -Z, outward), near_box_edge_in, z_min_ft, z_max_ft, horizontal (true/false). action: ANCH writes an ANCH support named tag-system-nn; FREE leaves the end free. Use with the translator's 'Add anchors at free ends' off.

boundary_rules.name: EXAMPLE model cut at the box edge
boundary_rules.note: PLACEHOLDER: anchor at the model boundary; replace with imposed displacements if the outside piping is modelled

boundary_rules.name: EXAMPLE equipment nozzle, vertical down
boundary_rules.note: PLACEHOLDER: flexible connector, end left free

boundary_rules.name: Open valve or flange end
boundary_rules.note: VFY: open end not matched to equipment

_comment_drop_fragments_max_components: Drop disconnected pieces of at most this many components (box-edge fragments). 0 or absent: keep all.
_comment_expected_collapse_match: Regex of component descriptions allowed to collapse to zero length without a warning. $^ matches nothing.
_comment_pcf_pipe_match: Regex that the PCF's pipe names match. With nwc_pipe_name_prefix, NWC pipe whose name does not match is listed in the report as missing from the PCF. Omit to skip that report.
_comment_nwc_pipe_name_prefix: Name prefix of pipe elements in the NWC items file (Revit family naming). Default Pipe-.
